# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_ENGULFING

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In a healthy EMA stack, a pullback to VWAP that forms an engulfing candle signals resumption of the prevailing trend. This captures the edge of buying weakness within an uptrend (or selling strength in a downtrend) with confluence of trend, VWAP, and candlestick pattern.

## Mechanism

For long: require EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon) AND price crosses below VWAP then closes above VWAP within the same 5‑min bar AND that bar is a bullish engulfing (body > prior bar body and close > prior bar high) AND RSI(14) between 40 and 60; enter at the bar’s close.  
Short: invert ribbon (EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50), price crosses above VWAP then closes below VWAP, bearish engulfing, RSI 40‑60, enter at close.  
Exit: stop at the most recent swing low (long) or swing high (short) identified via HH/LL; target at 1.5× risk or exit when price closes beyond the opposite VWAP side with an opposite engulfing candle.  
Regime hint: ideal when VIX is between 12‑22 and time 10:00‑14:30 ET (mid‑day trend); avoid first and last 30 minutes of the session.
